attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moves email-confirmation logic out of the shared UserDisplayDriver into the AdminController's Create/Edit actions, so any other code path (custom controllers, APIs, or modules) that relies on UserDisplayDriver.UpdateAsync to confirm emails will silently lose that behavior, and the new controller-bound EmailConfirmed flag is applied without checking canEditUser permissions, touching security-sensitive authentication flow."}
